scope: CAM-K2-E v1: matched GPU evaluation of CAM-K2 v2 seeds 1 and 2 against CAM-K1 seeds 1 and 2 under CAM-K2 v2's treatments (no_lidar, 66 x 54 deg, per-motor limit raised to T/W 4.0, thrust +-15 %, motor imbalance +-5 %, tau 0.02-0.04 s, OAK-D Pro depth model) on GR-0's S00 grid (4 densities x 3 seeds, quota 16), plus CAM-K2 v2 with the treatments off (F's vehicle: T/W 3.26, tau 0.04 s, exact depth) at 70 and 205 bars, after a 4-cell identity control; 64 cells, cap 3.5 h per stage with a rate gate, idle host; tools/camk2e_run.py
